description: Redraw the icons of an analysed screen as clean TRANSPARENT PNGs (crops carry the panel behind them and cannot be reused). Uses each crop as the reference so the symbol stays the same. 1 credit per 4 icons.

ids.description: specific element ids, default every icon

item.description: Library id of an analysed screen

out_dir.description: project root: icons land under gripforge/screens/<id>/icons/

style.description: art direction, e.g. "crisp flat white symbol"

name: gripforge_screen_icons
